title: Recent Progress for Single-Molecule Magnets Based on Rare Earth Elements
claim: Pentagonal-bipyramidal Dy SMMs with approximate D5h symmetry provide strong axial crystal fields and are associated with some of the higher reported barriers and blocking temperatures in this review.
explanation: The authors state that both the Ln center and the ligand field control anisotropy and that several confirmed pentagonal-bipyramidal SMMs share high axial D5h fields. Cited cases include Zheng's Dy(OtBu)2(py)5 with Ueff 1269.3 cm^-1 and TB 14 K, Chen's Cy3PO/aqua Dy complexes that first raised a Dy single-ion TB to 20 K (Ueff 472 and 543 cm^-1), and Canaj's [DyH(LN5)(Ph3SiO)2]+ with a barrier of 1108 cm^-1 that increased further when five equatorial N donors were introduced.
scope: Mononuclear Dy(III) SMMs in pentagonal-bipyramidal (D5h) coordination.
conditions: Axial anionic donors with a five-donor equatorial plane are the structural pattern highlighted.
caveats: Individual Ueff and TB values are molecule-specific; the review does not give one universal barrier for all D5h complexes. The text uses 'pentagonal biconical' for this geometry.
